toplevel: Stored-property initializers: selectedSessionType defaults to .overnight, extendedCaptureMode defaults to .both (overwritten onAppear by restoreCaptureMode), breathingAudio is a fresh BreathingAudioManager per view identity. Comment RecordView.swift:6-10 states all recording-state reads must go through the observed sub-objects, not collector forwarders.

flags.text: The pre-score feeling prompt (preScoreCover) is presented only via pendingMorningPresentation, which is set only by presentFullReport ← viewFullReportButton ← morningResultsPreview ← morningResultsPreviewSection, and that section excludes overnight and nap sessions. Overnight/nap readings auto-accept and jump to the Dashboard (routeOvernightAcceptance), so the 'Marco Altini moment' never fires for the overnight reading that docs say it gates; the morning feeling for overnight is only collectable from the Dashboard chip.

Tags and notes chosen before an overnight/nap recording (preSessionTagSection is shown for any selected type, default .overnight) live only in RecordView @State. The overnight path never writes them: routeOvernightAcceptance → autoAcceptOvernight scores and clears selectedTags/sessionNotes without calling persistTagsAndNotes. They are also lost if the view/app is recreated during the night. The Sections comment claims they persist at archive time via updateTags.

The header comment says RRCollector 'publishes nothing' so reads through collector do not trigger re-renders; RRCollector is @Observable and its stored vars are tracked (the Forwarders comment says so explicitly). The stale comment is the premise of the panel 'coupling' concerns and misleads future edits.

flags.text: The error alert is triggered by onChange of String(describing: lastError); lastError is never cleared by the alert's OK button or resetSession (RRCollector+Session.swift:8-20), so a second identical error (same description) does not change the key and no alert is shown.

Overnight/nap finalisation (re-score with HealthKit export + clearAcceptanceState) runs only from this view's onChange(of: needsAcceptance), which has no initial: true. The Record tab is a LazyView created on first tap, and finalizeFromPause can run without the UI (battery <=5% while paused). If needsAcceptance is already true when RecordView is first built, routeOvernightAcceptance never runs; the overnight acceptance/preview sections exclude overnight/nap, and isSessionActive stays true, so the Record tab shows no way to finish and the metrics are never exported.
